objective: Produce a current, read-only structural health assessment of the Scout knowledge library and identify whether any observed fact warrants a separate bounded maintenance goal.
context: The monorepo is expected at /app; the application is /app/projects/scout-knowledge-lib.app and the domain library is /app/projects/scout-knowledge-lib.

The deterministic observer is implemented in projects/scout-knowledge-lib.app/agents/scout/workflows/library-health.ts, and scripts/library-health-readonly.ts exposes its collection path without writing a runtime packet or emitting an event.
The starting checkout and every other worker worktree are read-only discovery sources. The worker creates and owns an isolated Git worktree before running commands that may write.
A health fact is evidence for review, not authority to edit the library or mutate May-agent task state.
acceptance: The focused library-health tests and read-only command tests pass in the goal-owned worktree.

The read-only command runs against that worktree's Scout app and domain library and reports its exact roots, generation time, fact count, wake-signal count, truncation state, facts, and wake decisions.
Git status and filesystem checks show that the assessment did not create app runtime state or change domain knowledge, reports, or digest content.

The final result classifies each fact kind that appeared, states whether a separate finite maintenance goal is justified, and reports any truncation or evidence limitation without treating an observation as a completed repair.
constraints: Do not edit the starting /app checkout or another worker's worktree; create an isolated goal-owned worktree for all execution.
Do not run the hosted library-health workflow because it writes .state/library-health-packets.jsonl and emits an event; use the read-only command.
Do not change Scout knowledge, reports, digest content, task state, credentials, schedules, or external services.
Do not simulate source data, expose credentials, or treat a clean command exit as proof that reported health facts were repaired.
Use the actual current date for the assessment and include the exact commands and revision in the final evidence.
